items.title: 方大同 Khalil Fong 2011专辑 Album《15》
items.creator: 方大同
items.description: 暌違三年，方大同終於推出全新創作專輯《15》。在氣胸害而被禁唱的期間，方大同苦練吉他，在新專輯展示他的苦練成果，新專輯的取名也是他從15歲開始學吉而來。《15》仍以吉他為概念主軸，融入藍調、復古搖滾元素。首波主打歌曲「好不容易」是整張專輯製作難度最高的一首歌，方大同花了最長時間來製作混音，弦樂方面也有60人參與。 15是方大同第五張全新國語大牒、15是方大同和吉他的重拾舊緣15是方大同開始學吉他的年齡這是一張回到「15」的專輯， 那樣年輕單純、那樣簡單快樂，同時充滿勇氣、力量、積極和創作慾望的一張專輯，也許你也會想到關於自己的15。 After a three-year hiatus, Khalil Fong has finally released his new album, *15*. During his hiatus from singing due to pneumothorax, Fong diligently practiced guitar, showcasing the results of his hard work on this new album. The album's title also reflects his experience of learning guitar at the age of 15. *15* continues the guitar-centric concept, incorporating blues and retro rock elements. The first single, "It Was Hard," was the most challenging track to produce on the album, requiring Fong to spend the most time on mixing, and involving 60 people in the string section. *15* is Khalil Fong's fifth new Mandarin album;

items.description: Acid Rap is the second mixtape by American rapper Chance the Rapper . It was released on April 30, 2013, as a free digital download. In July 2013, the album debuted at number 63 on the Billboard Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums , due to bootleg downloads on iTunes and Amazon not affiliated with the artist. [2] The mixtape has been certified "diamond" on mixtape site Datpiff, for garnering over 1,000,000 downloads. [3] It was rereleased on streaming services on June 21, 2019, alongside his 2012 mixtape 10 Day .

spares.title: Summer Knights
spares.creator: Joey Bada$$
spares.description: Summer Knights is the second mixtape by American rapper Joey Bada$$ . It was released on July 1, 2013, by Cinematic Music Group . The mixtape was planned to be released as an EP, to prelude the release of his debut album B4.DA.$$ , but instead it was announced to be a full-length mixtape. The mixtape features production from Chuck Strangers, Kirk Knight , MF Doom , Statik Selektah , DJ Premier , Lee Bannon , Oddisee , Navie D, and Bruce Leekix. The mixtape features more original instrumentals than his first mixtape 1999 which was primarily samples.
